papers.title: Adapting Vision Foundation Models to Acoustics for Pose-Free 3D Sonar Reconstruction
papers.summary: Adapts vision foundation models to imaging sonar using geometric modality relationships and physics-based synthetic noise to achieve pose-free 3D sonar reconstruction.
